name: Outdoor Heritage Fund Call for Funding Request
summary: Annual open call in Minnesota for habitat programmes and projects that restore, protect and enhance wetlands, prairies, forests and habitat for fish, game and wildlife. The council recommends winners to the legislature for appropriation.

amount.note: Requests under $500,000 go to the Conservation Partners Legacy Program.

eligibility.rule: Current with reporting requirements for past Outdoor Heritage Fund appropriations
Provide an up-to-date external audit or equivalent with no serious adverse findings
If acquiring land, requests or identifies funding to restore and enhance the acquired parcels
Submit no more than one funding request for the same project
No general organization support, overhead or fundraising from other sources

documents: Up-to-date external financial audit or equivalent

effort.quote: Complete the electronic application found at http://www.lsohc.mn.gov/FY2028/index_call by 4:00 p.m., Central Standard Time, Friday, May 22, 2026.
Be available to make a formal presentation, testify at meetings, answer questions as necessary and be queried by LSOHC members and staff based on accurate completion of the details provided;
Council Meeting: Review proposals and select proposals for hearings

eligibility.quote: Be current with all reporting requirements for past Outdoor Heritage Fund appropriations;
Provide an up-to-date external financial audit or its equivalent of your organization with no serious adverse findings;
Request funding or identify funding for the restoration and enhancement of acquired parcels.
Individual applicants cannot submit multiple requests for funding on the same project.
The funds may not be used for general organization support or overhead. Funds may not be used for fundraising from other sources.
